description: Delete a post that is still a draft, whether it was created in the Flomixy app or through the API. Scheduled, paused, publishing and failed posts cannot be deleted (409), and neither can published ones unless the environment is a dev/staging one that allows it; in that case the published post is also removed from each network and the result lists the outcome per network. Requires scope POSTS_DELETE, which is only offered to members allowed to delete posts. Check the post with get_post first: posts with the same caption on different networks are separate drafts, not duplicates.
name: delete_draft
title: Delete draft
